title: Associate Director - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 8-10 years in cloud and SAP infrastructure, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems.
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

  

* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Development, Reliability Engineering, SAP Infrastructure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: SAP BASIS S/4 HANA Administration
description:

Lead Administrator responsible for end to end administration of SAP S4HANA landscapes SAP BTP environments SAP HANA databases and NetWeaver ABAP or JAVA systems within a hybrid work model. Role involves ensuring high system availability secure operations and efficient performance for industrial manufacturing and automotive sector clients while collaborating with cross functional teams using English communication skills.

* Manage SAP S4HANA system landscapes by planning installation configuration and ongoing maintenance to ensure stable and efficient operations for business critical processes.
* Monitor SAP BTP services by tuning performance managing subaccounts and coordinating lifecycle operations to support scalable cloud native extensions and integrations.
* Administer SAP HANA databases by handling tenant management backup and recovery strategies and performance optimization to protect data integrity and minimize downtime.
* Configure and maintain SAP NetWeaver ABAP or JAVA application servers by managing instances transports and background jobs to support reliable application delivery.
* Execute SAP Basis administration tasks by managing client copies support packages system copies kernel updates and health checks to keep landscapes secure and compliant.
* Coordinate system refreshes and environment alignments by collaborating with functional and development teams to maintain consistency across development quality and production systems.
* Implement user and role administration by managing authorizations and security concepts to protect critical business data and ensure appropriate access controls.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues by analyzing logs traces and performance metrics to resolve incidents within agreed service levels and prevent recurring problems.
* Plan and support upgrade and migration activities by preparing detailed runbooks rehearsing cutover steps and validating post activity checks to ensure smooth transitions.
* Optimize system performance by fine tuning parameters managing workload distribution and analyzing capacity trends to improve response times and resource utilization.
* Collaborate with industrial manufacturing and automotive customer teams by understanding process requirements and translating them into robust technical configurations and operational practices.

* Demonstrate practical expertise in SAP BTP administration including subaccount management service configuration and connectivity setup for cloud solutions.

* Exhibit strong proficiency in SAP NetWeaver ABAP or JAVA administration covering instance management transport control and job scheduling activities.
* Highlight comprehensive SAP Basis skills such as system copies kernel maintenance support package implementation and technical monitoring using standard tools.
* Prefer exposure to industrial manufacturing or automotive industry processes to better align system configurations and operations with domain specific needs.
* Indicate ability to work effectively in a hybrid model by managing tasks independently coordinating virtually with teams and maintaining high standards of delivery.
* Confirm proficiency in English reading writing and speaking to support collaboration with global stakeholders and clear documentation of technical activities.

Your primary focus will be on Veritas NetBackup administration, with secondary responsibility for Commvault platforms, supporting backup, recovery, disaster recovery, cyber-resilience, and automation initiatives.

title: Associate Director - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**:

Every person, workload and AI agent at GSK needs an identity it can prove, credentials that cannot be stolen and access that is just enough, just in time. As our applications move to the cloud and AI agents begin working alongside our people, authentication is becoming the foundation of trust for everything we do. The Associate Director, leads the engineering and delivery of that foundation, starting with single sign-on (SSO) and extending the same discipline to Azure and Google Cloud (GCP), non-human identities (NHI) and AI agents.

**Our vision:**

  

One trusted way to authenticate, whoever or whatever is asking for access: passwordless for people, secretless for workloads and tightly scoped for AI agents. Security should be invisible when everything is right and decisive when it is not. We will get there by using AI securely in our own work, setting the example for the rest of GSK.

**About the team:**

  

Authentication and Cloud Security is part of Identity & Access Management. We build and run SSO for GSK’s workforce and applications, and bring the same discipline to securing the accounts, credentials and authentication of cloud, non-human and AI agent identities. Together with PKI & Cryptographic Services, we protect the identities, secrets and keys that GSK’s cloud and AI future depends on.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will turn that vision into reality. Your responsibilities will include:

* **Build one team:** Lead and develop a global team of engineers across SSO, cloud, NHI and AI agent identity, working as one team with shared patterns rather than separate product silos.
* **Deliver the roadmap:** Own the engineering roadmap, delivery plans and service measures, turning the agreed architecture and standards into reliable services.
* **Make sign-in passwordless and trusted:** Run GSK’s SSO services (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), moving the workforce to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication, with conditional access, strong identity verification for registration and account recovery, and the retirement of legacy authentication.
* **Secure the cloud:** Protect cloud accounts and access in Azure and GCP with strong authentication, workload identity federation, least privilege and just-in-time access, with no standing admin rights.
* **Bring workloads and AI agents into the fold:** Give non-human identities and AI agents unique, accountable identities kept separate from human ones, with protected credentials, scoped and revocable access and full audit logging, and promote integration with GSK’s identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* **Move from secrets to secretless:** Drive adoption of secrets vaulting and management, remove hard-coded credentials, favour short-lived and secretless authentication, and build secret scanning into engineering pipelines.
* **Partner with PKI:** Work with the PKI & Cryptographic Services lead to secure cloud, AI and secrets, with aligned roadmaps, clear ownership and a joined-up approach for stakeholders and auditors.
* **Use AI ourselves:** Apply AI to identity engineering and operations, such as risky sign-in analysis, anomaly detection, faster onboarding and incident triage, with human oversight and clear audit trails.
* **Set the example:** Show GSK what secure cloud and AI looks like through secure-by-default implementations, reusable patterns, automation and implementation guidelines.
* **Keep trust earned:** Ensure these services meet audit and compliance requirements, including GxP, SOX, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and lead major incidents and continual improvement with partner teams.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in computer science, information technology, cyber security or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 18 years’ experience in identity or security, including leading engineering teams that deliver and run enterprise identity or security services in a large organisation.
* Strong knowledge of SSO and modern authentication (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), conditional access, multi-factor authentication and passwordless authentication.
* Hands-on experience securing identity and access in Azure, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure role-based access control and workload identities.
* Experience securing non-human identities and secrets, including vaulting, credential rotation and removing embedded secrets, and integrating them with identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and large language model security risks, such as agent permissions, data exposure and prompt injection.
* Strong leadership, delivery and communication skills, including managing roadmaps, suppliers and audits, and explaining technical risk to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience delivering SSO at scale with Microsoft Entra ID or Ping Identity, including passwordless authentication and identity verification.
* Experience securing identity and access in Google Cloud (GCP), and with tools for securing non-human identity credentials and cloud privileged access.
* Experience with secrets vaulting and management platforms such as Akeyless, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault or Google Secret Manager.
* Experience securing AI agents or platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI or Copilot, and familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Working understanding of PKI and certificate-based authentication, and experience with Terraform and identity automation.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, Azure Security Engineer or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
* Experience in pharmaceuticals or another highly regulated industry.

Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, passkeys and FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, Azure, Google Cloud, Akeyless, CyberArk, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Graph, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Directory Services, Engineering Leadership, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secure Authentication, Security Controls, Server Security, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

description:
**About**

Going beyond the elementary impact of digital in terms of search, social and storytelling, marketers need to look at their customer journeys in the digital domains and focus their action based on insights of digital behaviour and contextise their marketing mix strategies and action.

Driving Indian Brands into the Digital First Marketing Era with our expertise in Data x Technology x Strategic Thinking x Creative Edge delivering agile Marketing Transformations \& Brand Performance.

**About the Role**

We operate a multi\-model data platform spanning traditional relational systems alongside vector and graph databases that power AI\-driven applications. As we scale, we need database engineers who can take ownership of the operational health of this stack: backup and recovery, patching and upgrades, performance tuning, and long\-term scalability planning. This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a narrow specialist role. You will work across PostgreSQL and emerging systems such as Milvus (vector) and Amazon Neptune (graph), with additional technologies such as Cognee likely joining the stack over time.

We are not looking for someone who already has years of production experience in every technology on this list — for some of these systems, that experience barely exists in the market. We are looking for someone with strong database fundamentals and the demonstrated ability to become the operational expert on an unfamiliar data system quickly, with minimal external support.

**What You Will Own**

* Define, implement, and test backup and recovery strategies across relational, vector, and graph database systems, including full and incremental backup, point\-in\-time recovery, and disaster recovery runbooks.
* Plan and execute patching and version upgrades for production database systems with minimal downtime and a documented rollback path.
* Diagnose and resolve performance and scaling issues across query performance, indexing, resource utilization, and storage growth.
* Build repeatable operational assets: golden backup templates, provisioning templates, monitoring baselines, and runbooks that reduce reliance on any single person's tribal knowledge.
* Partner with the platform lead to assess new data technologies as they are introduced and bring them to a production\-ready operational standard.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support and act as an escalation point for data\-layer incidents.

**What You Bring**

* 4\-8 years of hands\-on database engineering or DBA experience, with strong depth in at least one traditional RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server) covering backup/recovery, performance tuning, and upgrade management at production scale.
* Working production experience with at least one non\-relational system: a vector database (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant) or a graph database (e.g., Neptune, Neo4j, JanusGraph). Vector database experience is preferred over graph, but either is acceptable.
* A track record of independently learning and operationalizing a new database technology without formal training or vendor support – be ready to describe a specific instance of this in interviews.
* Solid grasp of core distributed data concepts (replication, sharding, consistency trade\-offs, indexing strategy) that transfer across relational and non\-relational systems.
* Comfort working in Linux environments, with scripting ability (Python or Bash) for automation of backup, monitoring, and operational tooling.
* Clear, structured communication – you will be documenting runbooks and explaining trade\-offs to both engineers and stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to AWS\-managed database services (RDS, Neptune, DocumentDB, or similar).
* Familiarity with a graph query language (Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL) or vector search concepts (embeddings, ANN indexing) beyond the required hands\-on system.
* Prior experience supporting an AI/ML or search\-heavy application from the data layer.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months**

* A documented, tested backup and recovery strategy is in place for Milvus, with recovery time objectives validated through an actual restore drill.
* A patching and upgrade process exists for at least one non\-relational system in the stack, with a rollback plan that has been tested at least once.
* You are trusted to independently triage and resolve a performance or scaling issue on an unfamiliar system with only documentation and your own investigation.

**Team Context**

You will join a small, high\-trust data platform team consisting of a technical lead and a junior engineer, with this role and one additional hire expanding the team's operational capacity. This is an individual contributor role with significant autonomy and direct exposure to architecture decisions.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Your future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. Capable of evaluating database environments, recommending improvements, documenting processes, and driving operational excellence and database best practices.
